name: Atari 100K Dataset
summary: 在 Atari 游戏中记录有限交互预算下的帧、动作、奖励和终止信号，用于模型式强化学习。
summaryEn: Frames, actions, rewards, and terminal signals from Atari games under a limited interaction budget for model-based RL.
scale: 100K interaction steps per Atari game benchmark protocol
scaleZh: 按每款 Atari 游戏 10 万步交互预算设置
access: Official benchmark implementations and data loaders available
accessZh: 官方基准实现和数据加载器可用
verdict: 有限交互下评测动作条件预测和规划的标准数据
verdictEn: A standard benchmark for action-conditioned prediction and planning under limited interaction
wmNote: 帧、动作和奖励序列直接支持模型式强化学习世界模型。
wmNoteEn: Frame, action, and reward sequences directly support model-based RL world models.
